skill.name: jeo
skill.description: JEO coordinates AI development workflows across Claude, Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenCode. It manages planning gates, execution handoffs, UI annotation loops, browser checks, and cleanup scripts.
skill.summary: Coordinate plan review, execution, UI feedback, and cleanup across AI coding agents.
skill.author: supercent-io

security_audit.summary: JEO has substantial operational power because it installs hooks, modifies agent configuration, runs external tools, and can edit project source. Many static matches are documentation or localhost false positives, but confirmed remote installer and persistence behaviors create high security risk.

remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell installation with pinned, checksummed packages and explicit user confirmation.
Require dry-run output, backups, and per-file confirmation before modifying Claude, Codex, Gemini, or OpenCode settings.

remediation.issue: Codex hook dispatcher executes registered scripts
remediation.suggestion: Restrict dispatcher registry entries to trusted absolute paths and show users every hook before enabling it.
Make Agentation injection opt-in and show a patch preview before writing application source files.
Default to list-only mode and require explicit per-worktree confirmation before removal, especially in force mode.

content.value_statement: Complex AI coding workflows can lose state, skip plan review, and miss UI feedback. JEO coordinates planning, execution, browser checks, annotation handling, and cleanup across major agent tools.
actual_capabilities: Creates and updates JEO workflow state under the project .omc directory.
Runs a mandatory plan review loop through plannotator before implementation.
Configures Claude, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode integrations through setup scripts.
Processes submitted agentation UI annotations and records their status.
Runs browser verification commands for local application URLs.
Removes extra git worktrees after a workflow is complete.
limitations: Requires local CLIs, shell access, Python, Node, and Git to be installed.
Setup scripts modify user-level AI tool configuration files.
Plan and annotation flows depend on local services and ports.
Worktree cleanup can remove local worktrees when used incorrectly.

faq.question: Which tools does JEO support?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode workflows.

faq.question: Does JEO write files outside my project?
faq.answer: Yes. Setup scripts can update Claude, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode configuration files in your home directory.

faq.question: Does JEO need network access?
faq.answer: Some setup paths use npm, npx, plugin marketplaces, or remote installer URLs.

faq.question: Can I use JEO only for planning?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the plan workflow and stop before execution or cleanup steps.

faq.question: What is the main safety concern?
faq.answer: The main concern is persistent agent hooks and configuration changes across multiple tools.

faq.question: How should teams evaluate it?
faq.answer: Audit the scripts, run in a sandbox, and approve each configuration change before shared use.
